description: Bounded public disposition for the Qwen3.8-27B ROCm side campaign: the HIP ladder with raw K0 at 17.35 t/s and accepted 29.19/34.25/33.90 t/s at K=1/2/4 (quiet session) against a loaded-session spread, the historical 42.11 t/s Vulkan record belonging to a different artifact, the wide-M verification bandwidth decay, and the iq4_nl KV defect (no HIP flash-attention kernel, silent CPU fallback, GPU fault). The executing runtime tree, model weights, container bytes, and raw receipts are excluded from publication; values below are sanitized summaries of campaign-local receipts.
model_revision: campaign artifact; no weight payload is part of this repository
model_download_source: public artifact exists; no weight payload or container byte is part of this repository
quant_name: IQ3_S weights (3.549 bpw) with q4_0 KV; iq4_nl KV reported as a defect
hardware_phenotype: RX9060XT16-NITRO-GFX1200-RADV-2026.08.27-v1; RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; ROCm/HIP 7.2.4 / HIP 7.2.53
gpu_configuration: RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; ROCm/HIP 7.2.4 / HIP 7.2.53
prompt: 18-token greedy canary prompt; single sequence, np 1, temp 0, top_k 1
warmup: quiet and loaded session classes reported separately

expected_range.iq4_nl_kv_outcome: no HIP flash-attention kernel; silent CPU fallback then a GPU fault

tolerance.accepted_tps: quiet vs loaded sessions differ by ~32%; only same-session comparisons are authoritative
tolerance.acceptance: exact speculative decoding verified by the target; acceptance is reported, not assumed

known_limitations: 34.25 and 42.11 must not be merged: different artifact, backend, and session.
The 42.11 record is HISTORICAL and its build was deleted.
The wide-M decay is a property of the verification pass, not a memory-system limit.
No ROCm production start command exists for this family; production runs Vulkan.
